test_title: PYST 22: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

During winters, most of the trains are not running on time in North India.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the present continuous tense "**are not running**" instead of the simple present tense "**do not run**."
 
• The simple present tense is more appropriate for habitual actions or general truths.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**do not run**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"During winters, most of the trains** do not run** on time in North India."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "on time in North India,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "most of the trains"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "During winters,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
